Also wrap the probe in a time limit (e.g. `timeout 120 uv run python -m kairos_defense.agent.probe -- make mcp`), per CLAUDE.md's rule that serving commands run with a time limit. The exit check names `make mcp`, so consider a slow test that drives `make mcp` itself; that would cover the silenced `@` recipe. Write out the exact command for the eight-tool `--allow-proposals` evidence, since `make mcp` takes no flags.

A6: the headline `swarm_top1` uses each query's whole observed flight, which is outside the §19.2 T grid. Record in DECISIONS before measuring that §19.3 gives no T for swarms and that the encore shows the whole flight, and keep `swarm_top1_by_t`, including T=180, in the report. DTW path: follow the conventions in `match/dtw_rerank.py`. Pass `use_c=True` everywhere (D-013/D-064, `require_c`). A5's banded `dtw_ndim.warping_path` may hit that bug. A monotone, end-covering check would not catch a wrong path, so also assert that the path's cost equals the banded distance.

summary: Approved. Checked against the phase 9 block, §14, §17.9–§17.10, §18, §19, §21, Appendix B, check_targets.py and gates.json. The plan covers all four checkboxes: swarm features, swarm_windows and matching; the Swarm view with formation edges, the afterglow ghost and the Director encore; agent tools, the MCP server (read-only by default, --allow-proposals) and the chat slide-over; the performance pass; DEMO.md and the README. Each §20 test bullet has a named test: demo swarm top-1 is S1-GOLF-260503, tool outputs are JSON-serializable, the server registers the six read-only tools, only proposal tools append and only match_proposed, and Playwright covers the encore. Every exit-check criterion maps to a command and evidence: rebuild and eval, make demo in the background, make e2e, check_targets.py 9 with the accepted live_top3 WARN (D-063/D-081), the encore specs, the stdio probe on make mcp, and the DEMO.md review. No CLAUDE.md rule is broken. Truth is read only in eval/, and the existing source scan covers the new packages. Swarm and agent searches filter to incidents that started earlier, with tests. The LLM stays off by default and the adapters are tested with mock transports. Tools use ports only, the ledger is append-only, agents only propose match_proposed (D-094), and the encore writes nothing (D-106). Docs, READMEs and the phase files are listed, and no human decision is needed. Main risks: swarm_top1 needs 4 of 4 answerable queries; make eval exits 1 on the accepted gap, so make demo must run as its own step; the MCP stdio test and probe need time limits; dtaidistance's C warping_paths has a band-edge bug that affects the swarm alignment path.
